overview.title: Proposal overview
overview.body: Evolve Offgrid Review from a queue-only reviewer into a shared workbench for operational items and complete planning documents.
points: Keep one offline HTML artifact and one apply boundary
Choose visual blocks according to the review question
Preserve a pure-text path for every diagram or chart

context.title: Why this belongs in the same engine
context.body:
Queue review and plan review ask the same fundamental question: what should a human approve, reject, annotate, or defer? The presentation changes, but persistence, risk signaling, review summaries, and exported decisions do not.

A document-oriented review therefore adds semantic blocks rather than a second product.

flow.title: Review and apply flow
flow.description: A proposal moves through deterministic preparation, human review, export, and verified application.

fallback: Review: a human inspects evidence and records explicit choices
Decision JSON: the console exports a portable approval artifact
Verified apply: a separate pass checks live state before mutation
